  FROM qualifying AS q

  INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON c."XCL_001" = r."XCL_068"
  WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

WITH q3_drivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q."XCL_058" AS driver_id
  FROM qualifying AS q
  INNER JOIN races AS r ON r."XCL_065" = q."XCL_057"
  INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON c."XCL_001" = r."XCL_068"
  WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
    AND r."XCL_066" = 2008
    AND q."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL
    AND q."XCL_064" <> ''
),
avg_flap AS (
  SELECT res."XCL_075" AS driver_id,
         AVG(
           CAST(SUBSTRING(res."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(res."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
           + CAST(SUBSTRING(res."XCL_088", INSTR(res."XCL_088", ':') + 1, INSTR(res."XCL_088", '.') - INSTR(res."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL)
           + CAST(SUBSTRING(res."XCL_088", INSTR(res."XCL_088", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
         ) AS avg_flap_sec
  FROM results AS res
  WHERE res."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
    AND res."XCL_088" <> ''
  GROUP BY res."XCL_075"
)
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
FROM q3_drivers AS qd
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d."XCL_034" = qd.driver_id
INNER JOIN avg_flap AS a ON a.driver_id = d."XCL_034"
WHERE a.avg_flap_sec > 85
ORDER BY d."XCL_040" DESC
LIMIT 1
